text_en: Hello, good day.
text_hi_latn: Namaste.

text_en: Am I speaking with the holder of the {brand_name} credit card?
text_hi_latn: Kya main {brand_name} credit card holder se baat kar rahi hoon?

text_en: I am calling about an offer available on your card. It will take about a minute.
text_hi_latn: Main aapke card par available ek offer ke baare mein call kar rahi hoon. Sirf ek minute lagega.

text_en: You are eligible to convert purchases above {min_txn_amt} rupees into easy monthly instalments. On your card, up to {eligible_amount} rupees can be converted over {tenure_options}.
text_hi_latn: Aap {min_txn_amt} rupees se upar ke purchases ko aasaan monthly instalments mein convert kar sakte hain. Aapke card par {eligible_amount} rupees tak, {tenure_options} mein convert ho sakta hai.
never_say: guaranteed approval|no interest|zero cost|free loan|pre-approved loan

text_en: At a tenure of {tenure_months} months, your indicative instalment would be about {indicative_emi} rupees per month.
text_hi_latn: {tenure_months} mahine ki tenure par, aapki indicative instalment lagbhag {indicative_emi} rupees monthly hogi.

text_en: Shall I connect you to our advisor to take this forward?
text_hi_latn: Kya main aapko hamare advisor se connect karoon, aage badhane ke liye?
never_say: your loan is approved|the amount will be credited

text_en: Thank you. Please stay on the line.
text_hi_latn: Dhanyavaad. Kripya line par bane rahiye.

text_en: Of course. The offer is open for {offer_valid_days} days. Would you prefer that our advisor explains the details now, or should we call you back?
text_hi_latn: Bilkul. Yeh offer {offer_valid_days} din tak khula hai. Kya advisor abhi details samjhaayein, ya hum aapko baad mein call karein?

text_en: That is a fair question. I am not asking for any card number, PIN or OTP, and I never will. You can also verify this offer on your {brand_name} app, or by calling the number printed on the back of your card. Shall I continue?
text_hi_latn: Yeh sahi sawaal hai. Main aapse koi card number, PIN ya OTP nahi maang rahi hoon, aur na hi kabhi maangungi. Aap yeh offer apne {brand_name} app par ya card ke peeche likhe number par bhi verify kar sakte hain. Kya main aage badhoon?

text_en: I am calling on the number registered with your {brand_name} card account. If you would prefer not to receive such calls, I can note that right away.
text_hi_latn: Main aapke {brand_name} card account par registered number par call kar rahi hoon. Agar aap aise calls nahi chahte, main abhi note kar sakti hoon.

text_en: Certainly. We will call you back at a more convenient time.
text_hi_latn: Zaroor. Hum aapko kisi convenient time par dobara call karenge.

text_en: I apologise for the inconvenience. I will update our records.
text_hi_latn: Asuvidha ke liye khed hai. Main hamare records update kar dungi.

text_en: I understand. May we call you back later today?
text_hi_latn: Main samajh sakti hoon. Kya hum aaj baad mein call karein?

text_en: I am sorry, I could not hear you. Are you still there?
text_hi_latn: Maaf kijiye, main aapko sun nahi paayi. Kya aap line par hain?

text_en: Certainly.
text_hi_latn: Zaroor.

text_en: That is a good question, and I would rather our advisor answer it properly for you.
text_hi_latn: Yeh accha sawaal hai, aur behtar hoga ki hamare advisor aapko iska sahi jawaab dein.

text_en: That is perfectly alright. Thank you for your time, and have a good day.
text_hi_latn: Koi baat nahi. Aapke time ke liye dhanyavaad, aapka din accha ho.

text_en: Thank you. Have a good day.
text_hi_latn: Dhanyavaad. Aapka din accha ho.

text_en: I have noted your request. You will not receive further promotional calls from us. Thank you.
text_hi_latn: Maine aapka request note kar liya hai. Aapko aage promotional calls nahi aayengi. Dhanyavaad.

text_en: Thank you, and sorry for the disturbance.
text_hi_latn: Dhanyavaad, aur pareshaani ke liye khed hai.

text_en: I am ending the call now. Thank you.
text_hi_latn: Main call ab end kar rahi hoon. Dhanyavaad.

text_en: I am unable to hear you. We will try again another time. Thank you.
text_hi_latn: Main aapko sun nahi paa rahi. Hum phir kabhi try karenge. Dhanyavaad.
